# Vikram Sra — Duar

> Vikram Sra is a Sikh Punjabi oil painter based in Toronto, Canada. Duar (https://duar.one) is his online portfolio, interactive 3D virtual art gallery, and studio archive.

## Summary & Identity
- **Artist**: Vikram Sra (ਵਿਕਰਮ ਸਰਾ)
- **Profession**: Oil Painter, Contemporary Visual Artist
- **Location**: Toronto, Ontario, Canada (born and raised in Punjab, India)
- **Practice / Studio**: Duar (Gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਰ, meaning doorway or portal), duar.one
- **Founder**: Duar Art Club (Toronto artist-run space and collective)
- **Primary Medium**: Oil on canvas, acrylic on handmade paper, custom fabrication
- **Core Themes**: Formless inner spaces, migration and diaspora, the tension between ancestral heritage and the looseness of the present, human emotion, spiritual longing, and light.

## Primary Pages & URLs
- [3D Virtual Gallery](https://duar.one/): Real-time interactive 3D exhibition space under a celestial sky tracking real time.
- [Artwork Catalogue](https://duar.one/work/): Complete catalogue of 51 paintings with series groupings, canvas dimensions in inches, medium specifications, and availability.
- [Artist Biography & Statement](https://duar.one/about/): Full artist statement, biography, comprehensive exhibition CV, and contact details.

## Artist Statement
"I paint the formless spaces within: the worlds that stay hidden until someone gives them the quiet attention they need to take shape. What I am after is the part we cannot see with our eyes. The heavy architecture of love and hope. The sharp edges of hate and despair. The presence of both God and the demons we carry.

I am a Sikh Punjabi painter, born and raised in Punjab, now based in Toronto. I work mostly in oil and I am largely self-taught.

I take the measure of those things from watching people move across land, and from what the moving does to them inside. Some of it is first-hand — I left Punjab for Toronto at eighteen. The tension I keep returning to sits between the weight of heritage and the looseness of now, and staying with it means giving up control of the time that has passed and the time that has not arrived."

## Exhibitions
- **2026**: *Insides* — The Plumb, Toronto (Group show)
- **2024**: *What worked for me I never paid into, What I worked at never paid off* — Hearth, Toronto (Group show)
- **2024**: *Kaal* — Duar Art Club, Toronto (Group show on time)
- **2021–22**: *Pancakes and Booze* — Toronto (Community group show)
- **2016**: *Tabeer* — IX Gallery, Toronto (Group show with Navi Sandhu)
- **2015–17**: *Sikh Heritage Month* — Peel Art Gallery, Museum and Archives (PAMA), Brampton
- **2015–17**: *Sikh Activist Network* — Brampton (Community group shows)

## Residencies
- **2025**: Preet Nagar — Amritsar, Punjab
- **2024**: Road to Elefsina — Athens, Greece
- **2020**: Gibraltar Point — Artscape, Toronto
